title: Japanese Studies Fellowship Program
about: The Japan Foundation's Japanese Studies Fellowship Program funds long-term, short-term and doctoral research fellowships starting between June 2027 and March 2028. Applications close 1 December 2026 (1:00 p.m. Japan time; US applicants 11:59 p.m. EST).
requirements: Categories: long-term research (4-12 months), short-term research (21-89 days), doctoral fellowships (4-12 months)
Doctoral candidates must be Ph.D. candidates in humanities or social sciences who have completed or will complete coursework by the fellowship start
Fellowships must begin between 20 June 2027 and 20 March 2028
US applicants apply via The Japan Foundation, New York (deadline 11:59pm EST, 1 December 2026)
